extracted.intended_audience: journalists, media professionals, and the general public seeking police/fire/authority press releases
extracted.subtask_description: Conventions and structural elements used in German police/fire/bundesbehörden press releases as aggregated on a public press-portal (date/time, location, issuing authority, short lead, contact info, tags, links). Useful for producing or evaluating short public-safety press statements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Timestamp
rubrics_metrics.description: Each entry is stamped with a precise publication date and time (format seen: DD.MM.YYYY – HH:MM).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example on page: "10.05.2026 – 22:16". Place the timestamp prominently at the top of the release so readers and media see when the item was published.

rubrics_metrics.name: Location tag with 'ots' marker
rubrics_metrics.description: Press releases include the place name followed by "(ots)" (e.g., "Viernheim (ots)").
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example: "Viernheim (ots)". Use the city/town of the incident or issuing office and append "(ots)" to indicate the origin of the press message.

rubrics_metrics.name: Issuing authority / Dienststelle
rubrics_metrics.description: The publishing authority (e.g., Polizeipräsidium Südhessen, Polizeidirektion Landau, Feuerwehr Oberhausen) is shown immediately with the item.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example entries show lines like "Polizeipräsidium Südhessen" or "Polizeidirektion Landau". Always name the exact agency/unit responsible for the information.

rubrics_metrics.name: Press identifier / code (Kurzkennzeichen)
rubrics_metrics.description: A short case/press code prefix identifies the message (e.g., "POL-HP:", "POL-ST:").
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples: "POL-HP: Geparkter Mercedes beschädigt. Verursacher flüchtet...", "POL-ST: Steinfurt, Tödlicher Verkehrsunfall auf der B54...". Use the standard prefixing convention to help tracking and searching.

rubrics_metrics.name: Short lead summary (one-paragraph factual lead)
rubrics_metrics.description: A concise lead sentence or short paragraph immediately summarizes the incident's core facts (who/what/when/where/outcome).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Leads commonly begin with a hyphen and present brief factual sentences, e.g., "- Die Polizei in Lampertheim ermittelt in einem Fall von Verkehrsunfallflucht..." Keep the lead neutral, factual and focused on the essential facts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Structured factual details (who/when/where/what/consequences)
rubrics_metrics.description: The body supplies key incident details: time, location, parties involved (including ages), vehicle types, injuries, property damage, and immediate consequences (e.g., road closures, rescue actions).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples: ages and vehicles are given ("ein 64-jähriger Mann", "PKW Mercedes"); events note injuries and response ("Zwei Rettungshubschrauber eingesetzt"). Follow a predictable fact-first structure and avoid speculation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Status tags (ERSTMELDUNG / Abschlussmeldung / Korrektur)
rubrics_metrics.description: Releases sometimes include explicit status markers such as "ERSTMELDUNG", "Abschlussmeldung" or correction notices to indicate whether information is preliminary, final, or corrected.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples: "ERSTMELDUNG: Am Sonntagnachmittag..." and "POL-WI: +++Korrektur der Pressemeldung:...+++" Use these markers to signal reliability and updates to earlier information.

rubrics_metrics.name: Call for witnesses / request for Hinweise
rubrics_metrics.description: When appropriate, the release asks the public for observations or information (e.g., "Wer konnte den Vorfall beobachten oder kann Hinweise zu dem Unfallverursacher geben?").
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include explicit phrasing that invites witnesses to contact the listed police station or hotline; provide concrete contact routes for tips.

rubrics_metrics.name: Media contact information (Rückfragen)
rubrics_metrics.description: Many items include a 'Rückfragen' line giving telephone and/or fax numbers for media inquiries and further information.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example: "Rückfragen von Medienvertretern bitte an: Kreispolizeibehörde Hochsauerlandkreis Leitstelle Telefon: 0291-9020-3110 Fax: ..." Always provide a named contact and phone/fax (or email) for press follow-up.

rubrics_metrics.name: Metadata tags for filtering (Dienststellen / Bundesland / Medien / Zeitraum)
rubrics_metrics.description: Entries are categorized by issuing office, federal state, media type (Videos, Bilder, Audios, Dokumente) and time period to allow portal filtering.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Portal filters shown: "Dienststellen: Polizei/Feuerwehr/Bundesbehörden...", "Bundesland: Bayern/Berlin...", "Medien: Videos/Bilder/Audios/Dokumente", "Zeitraum: Gestern/Letzte 7 Tage". Apply these tags/fields to releases to improve discoverability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide full text or expanded details via a 'mehr' link
rubrics_metrics.description: Each summary links to the full press release or extended reporting with a 'mehr' (more) link.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The listing shows "mehr" after many items. Ensure the portal entry links to the complete release, attachments, or multimedia so journalists can access full information.

rubrics_metrics.name: Neutral, factual tone and brevity
rubrics_metrics.description: Language is neutral, non-sensational, and concise, focusing on verifiable facts rather than opinion or conjecture.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples across items show restrained reporting: short sentences, factual verbs. Avoid emotive language and unconfirmed details.

rubrics_metrics.name: Include technical/scene details where relevant (road sections, junctions, vehicle directions)
rubrics_metrics.description: For traffic and incident reports, the text often specifies road names, junctions, driving direction and technical response (e.g., which tunnel tube, which junctions were closed).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples: "zwischen den Anschlussstellen Sonnenschein und Metelen", "BAB 671". Such details help responders, media and the public understand impact and scope.

rubrics_metrics.name: Instruction on use of personal data/images in public searches
rubrics_metrics.description: When a missing person is found, releases may request media to delete previously published personal data/photos (e.g., "Die Medien werden gebeten, die ... persönlichen Daten, insbesondere das Lichtbild, zu löschen.").
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include explicit editorial requests for deletion or modification of previously released images/data where privacy or safety requires it.

rubrics_metrics.name: Solicit and report on subsequent operational outcomes (rescues, arrests, follow-up)
rubrics_metrics.description: Releases routinely report follow-up outcomes (e.g., person found safe, rescue performed, suspects arrested) to close the information loop.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples: "Der seit heute ... gesuchte 14-jährige Junge ... ist wohlbehalten aufgefunden worden." Use clear follow-up statements labeled as 'Abschlussmeldung' or similar to update previous ERSTMELDUNG items.
